$comment: Project permissions for agents working in this repo, so ordinary read-only and
Deny rules must use Edit(...), not Write(...): Claude Code matches every
file-editing tool against Edit rules and silently ignores Write ones. An earlier
version of this file used Write and therefore denied nothing at all.
Be clear about what the allow list does and does not do. It widens Bash only. It
does not restrain file writing — a room agent running with acceptEdits can create
or overwrite any file it can reach while still being unable to run `ls -R`. That
asymmetry is real and backwards; the deny list is what narrows reach, and the
ripieno.agentPermissions setting decides whether commands run unattended at all.
Also note a headless room agent cannot answer an approval prompt: without the
extension's approval bridge, anything needing one strands rather than being denied.
